difficulty_reason: The proof requires a descent-constrained Demazure basis for the quotient and explicit identification of each basis piece with a generalized projective 0-Hecke module. Its prerequisite new local core includes straightening and triangularity arguments together with the alpha/i module construction, retained in the editable body. These uniform representation-theoretic constructions for every n,k exceed ordinary PhD qualification calculations; the final binomial multiplicity alone is not the difficulty claim.
